rules.statement: IF-001 must be provided as a required custom write interface (enable + data) on the producer side in the CLK-WR domain, with input data and output flags.
IF-002 must be provided as a required custom read interface (enable + data) on the consumer side in the CLK-RD domain, with input enable and output data and flags.
IF-003 must provide the required internal interconnect (wr to mem write port, rd to mem read address, mem to rd read data) spanning CLK-WR and CLK-RD.
IF-004 must be provided as a required software reset control (level input request, optional busy output status) in the CLK-WR domain.
